download_lcb_v5: run the download_lcb script to download and save LiveCodeBench v5 dataset to a JSON file
download_lcb_v6: run the download_lcb script to download and save LiveCodeBench v6 dataset to a JSON file
download_lcb_custom_dataset: run the download_lcb script with a custom dataset name and split to filter by date range
download_lcb_custom_workers: run the download_lcb script with a custom number of max workers for parallel JSON export
download_lcb_custom_version: run the download_lcb script specifying v5 or v6 version to filter contest dates accordingly
